_readme: S528 SkyMulberry, 2026-10-30. Of Glendale's 46 records that sum unequal to their total, 29 price every course, so each gap is the reading, not a missing price. This read prints the pages for five of them, in the catalog's own words: Digital Content Specialist (p73, sums 21 against 23), Foreign Languages and the French and Italian pair (pp76-77, the pair sum 23 against 18-20 with an elective the page makes conditional on the core), Music A.S. (p83, 21-22 against 22) and Photography (p84, 27 against 18). One load of the 2025-2026 PDF, no model call.

questions.unequal_sums: For each named program, every course its page lists and the total it states, so the record's gap can be named: a missed or extra course, a conditional block, or a borrowed total.
